name: workflow_finish
description: Terminate the workflow run and return a final summary to the calling outer session. Call this when the orchestrator has determined the workflow's goal is achieved — typically after a decide step routes to a terminal branch. Once called, the run is immutable: no further workflow_* tools may be invoked against this runId. The orchestrator session typically ends shortly after this call.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what the run produced or why it ended. Returned to the outer session.

result.description: Optional structured result payload to hand back to the outer session (e.g. final ctx slice the caller cares about).
